title: Variable distinctness under CNF dualization
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\psi$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables. Suppose that in every clause of $\psi$, any two literals with the same variable are equal. Then in every term of the De Morgan dual DNF of $\psi$, any two literals with the same variable are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $\psi$ is a CNF formula on $n$ variables
In each clause, literals with the same variable are equal
replaced:
Let $\psi$ be a CNF formula on $n$ variables with the property that, within each of its
clauses, any two literals having the same variable are in fact the same literal (so no
variable occurs in a clause with both polarities, nor is any literal repeated). Then the
De Morgan dual DNF obtained from $\psi$ by negating every literal has the same property
term by term: within each of its terms, any two literals sharing a variable are equal.
